_meta.units: margin_rel = plot-region edge to curmin (or curmax) distance / min(canvas W, H); lo is the left or bottom side, hi the right or top

notes: (note:  named style bogus not found in class margin, default attributes used)

BY_B10.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign) plotregion(margin(b+10))

BY_L10.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign) plotregion(margin(l+10))

BY_ZERO.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign) plotregion(margin(zero))

notes: (note:  named style L not found in class gsize, default attributes used)

COPY.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(margin(zero)) plotregion(margin(l+10))

COPYR.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(margin(l+10)) plotregion(margin(zero))

I3.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(ilcolor(red) ilwidth(thick))

I4.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(ifcolor(red%50) ilpattern(dash))

I5.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(istyle(none) ifcolor(red))

I6.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(ifcolor(red) margin(zero))

I7.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(ifc(red) ilc(blue))

notes: (note:  named style l5 not found in class margin, default attributes used)

L5L5.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(margin(l+5 l+5))

LOG.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, yscale(log) plotregion(margin(b+10))

MIX.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, plotregion(margin(zero) color(red)) plotregion(mar(t+5))

notes: (note:  named style a not found in class gsize, default attributes used)
(note:  named style sides not found in class gsize, default attributes used)

REV.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, xscale(reverse) plotregion(margin(l+10))

XS.cmd: twoway scatter mpg weight, xsize(10) ysize(3) plotregion(margin(l+10))

Y2.cmd: twoway (scatter mpg weight) (scatter price weight, yaxis(2)), plotregion(margin(t+10))
